_comment: CH_COLOR_MASK_V1 — opt-in packed color-customization mask emitted by the CH Blender authoring pipeline.
description: Packed RGB semantic recolor mask aligned pixel-for-pixel with the pre-rendered sprite. Alpha is object coverage, not a fourth recolor channel.

policy.alignment: same camera, AssetRoot rotation, resolution and pivot as color pass
policy.postProcess: downsample only; never palette-quantize or dither masks
policy.runtimeTinting: separate runtime concern; authoring contract only guarantees mask output and metadata

blenderImportRules.partOverride: Imported blend/fbx/glb parts may declare maskRole to classify the whole imported object set.
blenderImportRules.unassignedBehavior: Rendered black in RGB while remaining inside alpha coverage. It is not recolored at runtime.

constraints: Do not use alpha as a fourth tint channel in V1.
Do not put lighting, AO or cast shadows into the color mask.
Do not color-mask glass, emissive signs or special materials unless design explicitly calls for recoloring them.
Every declared semantic role must be assigned to at least one rendered material or object.
Mask-enabled assets still follow preflight -> SOUTH proxy -> human review -> final bake for new agent-authored geometry.
V1 is intended for solid building/prop surfaces; cutout foliage and texture-alpha meshes require a later alpha-aware extension.
